items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And we got a trio, and the Birdland tours started coming around, with -- that's the band that Basie had with Thad Jones and Frank Foster, Frank Wess, Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: And we got a trio, and the Birdland tours started coming around, with -- that's the band that Basie had with Thad Jones and Frank Foster, Frank Wess, Ernie Wilkins. And Joe Williams was the singer. Quite a package.
